items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I think Harry Belafonte had a little voiceover thing.

ctx.x: Cyrus Chestnut, but also the woman piano player, Allen, Geri Allen playing Mary Lou Williams. Each one of them — they didn’t come out and say they were these people but they were modeled on these people. And it was Kansas City the way it used to be but coming back to life. And incredible music. And one thing segued into another thing, there was no talking. I think Harry Belafonte had a little voiceover thing. But it’s an incredible film. I mean it’s not a documentary but it recreated, it could have almost been…
Well that was a question I should have prepared you for. What do you listen to these days as far as jazz?
